[G] DiagramService
=======================================================================
DiagramService = sole content writer
  create(input)     revise(baseRevisionId, edit)     generate(request)
       |                       |                         |
       +--> DiagramRevisionEditor <--- generator result --+
                    | prepareCreate / prepareEdit
                    v
  issue(prepared, base?) -> diagramRevisions.register
    revision: id, diagramId, parentId?, diagram, nodeRefs
    mapped old node -> preserve nodeRef; new node -> UUID
                    |
                    v
  DiagramRevisionResult = prepared edit + issued revision
  getRevision(id) / listRevisions(diagramId); no-op reuses base
Source: domain/core/diagrams/diagramService.ts
